description: Options for creating a gRPC client.

AllowUnsafeConnection.description:
Accept any server certificate instead of verifying it: `1`, `true`, `yes`, `enable`,
`allow` or `authorize`, and their negatives; empty for false.

CaCert.description: Path to the Certificate Authority file, in PEM format; empty for the system CAs.

CertPem.description: Path to the client certificate file, in PEM format; set together with `KeyPem`.

ConnectTimeout.description: Timeout for establishing a connection to the server (e.g. `30s`), empty for 60s.

Http2KeepAliveInterval.description: HTTP/2 PING frame interval (e.g. `20s`), empty for no keepalive.

Http2KeepAliveTimeout.description: HTTP/2 PING timeout (e.g. `10s`), empty for no timeout.

Http2KeepAliveWhileIdle.description:
Send HTTP/2 keepalive PINGs even when idle; spelled like `AllowUnsafeConnection`,
empty for false.

Http2MaxHeaderListSize.description: HTTP/2 max header list size in bytes, empty for no limit.

KeyPem.description: Path to the client key file, in PEM format; set together with `CertPem`.

OverrideTargetName.description: Override the endpoint name during SSL verification.

Proxy.description:
HTTP proxy used to reach the endpoint: empty or `system` to follow the environment,
`none` for a direct connection, otherwise the proxy URL, whose scheme has to be
`http`.

ProxyPassword.description:
Password for proxy authentication; mutually exclusive with credentials written into
the `Proxy` URL.

ProxyUsername.description:
Username for proxy authentication; mutually exclusive with credentials written into
the `Proxy` URL.

RateLimit.description:
Rate limit for requests, written `count/duration` (e.g. `100/1s`), empty for no rate
limit.

TcpKeepalive.description: TCP keepalive duration (e.g. `30s`), empty for no keepalive.

TcpKeepaliveInterval.description: Interval between TCP keepalive probes (e.g. `5s`), empty for the OS default.

TcpKeepaliveRetries.description: Number of TCP keepalive retries, empty for the OS default.

TcpNagleAlgorithm.description:
Enable Nagle's algorithm (disable TCP_NODELAY); spelled like `AllowUnsafeConnection`,
empty for false.

Timeout.description: Timeout for each request (e.g. `30s`), empty for no timeout.

UserAgent.description: User-Agent header value sent with each request.
